title: Garden and Thorn Revisited
author: O. M. Nakamura
blurb: Silas Reyes, the youngest member of a dying guild, has spent five years selling small charms in a city that outlawed magic. But when a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must unbind a king from the thing wearing his crown, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
